//: Settings the modules read, for the hosts' user secrets (bjk-core, bjk-identity-server). Copy the sections a host needs into its own user-secrets.template.json. Locally these values are for development only; in Azure they come from Key Vault and container settings.

Safety.//: RequireAgeVerification defaults to false since 19 Oct 2026: posting, commenting and reacting no longer need the age check (it is only for viewing sensitive posts). Kept for future use; true makes write endpoints need the age_verified claim.

Posts.//: Where incidents may be posted: GB (the UK, the default when empty), IM (Isle of Man), JE (Jersey), GG (Guernsey).

Screening.//: Keywords (default) uses the built-in list only. Http adds a classifier service (e.g. Detoxify in a sidecar): POST {"text"} -> {"scores": {...}}.

Captcha.//: Same keys as the identity server. Cloudflare's test secret below accepts every token (clients send XXXX.DUMMY.TOKEN.XXXX). Provider AlwaysPass skips the check entirely (tests only).

Messaging.//: Durable queues in SQL Server (schema messaging of the app database); every key is optional and shown with its default. bjk-core leaves ConnectionStringName empty (its AppDatabase). The identity server sets ConnectionStringName to Messaging (a login limited to the messaging tables of badjockeys) and CreateTables to false. See the README's Messaging section.

Media.//: Defaults shown; set only to change them. Limits since 19 Oct 2026: videos 30 s and 150 MB (157286400 bytes), photos 25 MB. Originals are deleted once their post is published; UnusedOriginalRetention is the most they're kept otherwise (failed, never posted).

Storage.//: SensitiveBucket: private bucket for the real files of sensitive media (served only by signed links). Optional; empty = the originals bucket under sensitive/. Set it (e.g. bjk-<env>-sensitive, no lifecycle rule, no public access) wherever the originals bucket deletes files after 90 days.

Processing.//: Worker only. Videos longer than SegmentSeconds are split into segment jobs processed in parallel by several replicas (0 = never split). FfmpegThreads 0 = every core of the replica. Keep MaxConcurrentJobs at 1 (one job per replica) and scale replicas. FeedImageMaxSize: longest side of photos' feed.webp copy.

Redaction.//: Worker only. Video frames are analysed at most DetectionMaxSize px (0 = full size). InferenceThreads 0 = every core. ExecutionProvider Cpu; Cuda only on a GPU worker image built with Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime.Gpu.

SensitiveDetection.//: Worker only. Automatic graphic content detection, scored on the blurring pass's frames. Off until a model is chosen; once Enabled, a missing or failing model sends every upload to review. Provider Onnx (ModelPath, NCHW RGB input, normalised with Mean/Std, first output [1, classes]; SensitiveClasses = graphic class indices; Output Softmax|Sigmoid|Probabilities) or Development (flags mostly red pictures; Development environment only). Threshold is low on purpose (over-flag; moderators confirm or undo).
